fieldNotes.truckGate: Central guarded checkpoint deep inside the campus: a large flat canopy spanning the truck lanes with a small ~1-vehicle guard booth beside it, plus E-W lane markings with directional arrows. Confirmed at z19-z20 satellite over roster coords.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small windowed booth (~1-vehicle footprint) set beside the canopy lanes at the central checkpoint; a second smaller guard structure controls the SE east-yard entrance.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because a staffed guard booth is present at the gate.
fieldNotes.multiStep: Two checkpoint stages: a primary canopy guard checkpoint on the central spine, then a separate SE guard/gate controlling access to the east trailer drop yards.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of 3+ large buildings: the angled cross-dock depot (NW), a giant DC warehouse (center-east), and an annex/DDC building (south).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+. The DC warehouse west face alone has dozens of trailers backed in along a continuous dock line; the cross-dock depot building adds a long bank of doors. Total estimated ~140 across faces, flagged as approximate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+. Multiple large drop yards: a canal-side yard on the SW, a very large multi-row trailer yard on the east, and a north laydown yard. Hundreds of parked trailers visible.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock clusters on different building faces (DC west face vs cross-dock depot face) plus separate east drop yards imply separated ship/receive flows.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Multiple controlled access points (central canopy checkpoint + SE east-yard checkpoint) with one-way lane arrows indicate separated entry/exit routing through the campus.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane canopy apron with substantial paved width at the central checkpoint leaves room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Tracy industrial park; farmland to the south and east and the Delta-Mendota/California Aqueduct canal on the SW. Per rubric, edge-of-town industrial classes as Rural.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: False; large modern DC in an active industrial park with town/utilities adjacent to the north, so cellular coverage is expected to be adequate despite the rural fringe.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified in overhead imagery; left uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; the nearest linear features are roads and the canal, not track.
fieldNotes.streetView: Only public-road Street View coverage is the S Schulte Ct cul-de-sac frontage pano (wXQePY-JhcdhnUjTG8rQKw, 2019-03) showing the depot office face; the internal guarded checkpoint has no Street View coverage (ZERO_RESULTS), so truckGate hasCoverage is false.
